title: Roommates university student with a campus job (5 classes, Canvas, evening steady) told Dev starting is the hard part and she loses hours once she is in; Sunday night she says the Drawing piece ate her evening and Spanish is untouched. Dev offers a small first step in tomorrow's study window with a stop time, no shame.

changes.content: I have ADHD. Starting is the hard part for me, and once I'm into something I lose track of time. A tiny first step helps and a stop time helps. Don't make me feel bad about it.
Got into the Drawing piece at 7 and looked up at 10. Haven't touched the Spanish homework and I can't make myself start it now.

dev_must_notice.what: Spanish homework 12 is due tomorrow, Monday Nov 23, 11:59 PM (asg-span-292-homework-12) and she says it is untouched (m-slid) after her Sunday evening study window (7 to 9:45 PM) went to the Drawing piece. It is 10:15 PM and she goes to bed around 12:15 AM; her evening study never runs after 11 PM. Tomorrow's Monday evening window (7 to 9:45 PM) is free: no shift on Mondays and Math homework 13 is not due until Tuesday Nov 24 (asg-math-108-homework-13). She told Dev what helps: a tiny first step and a stop time (m-start).

best_fix.what: One calm line and one tap: 'Nothing is lost, Spanish is due tomorrow night and Monday evening is free. Want me to put it at 7:00 PM with a first step of just opening it and doing item 1, and a stop at 8:30?' [Add it]. Also add Math homework 13 on Tuesday evening at the same time, 7:00 to 8:30 PM, so it does not slide the same way. Both come with Undo. Tonight: nothing more to do, go to sleep.
best_fix.why: A small first step and a stop time are what she said works (m-start); the block sits in her firm evening window (m-01 in her routines) and ends well before her 11 PM limit; she keeps a night's sleep.

placements.label: Spanish homework: open it, do item 1, stop at 8:30
Math homework 13: open it, do item 1, stop at 8:30

tempting.suggestion: tell her to start the Spanish homework tonight at 10:30 PM and push through
tempting.why_wrong: her evening study ends by 11 PM and she sleeps around 12:15 AM; tomorrow's window is free and the due time is 11:59 PM

must_not: tell her to start the Spanish homework tonight after 10 PM
use shame or guilt words (lazy, should have, you always)
diagnose, explain her ADHD or call this a symptom; only use what she told Dev
write, solve or check the Spanish or Math homework (planning only)
book a long open block with no stop time
add blocks outside her evening window or on her Tuesday shift 2 to 5 PM
tell her to start the Spanish homework tonight at 10:30 PM and push through
assumptions: She wrote her own words about ADHD; Dev saves them as a user memory and never labels or explains it.
Study at home in the evening window records as a calendar block, so the Sunday slide is visible only through her words.
